facts: Install GPU burn tool, run 12 hours and check GPU sensors.
Criterion is tool PASS; machine time is 240 minutes.
source_snapshot.v2: MANUAL ONLY with tool provenance, continuous sensors and restoration.

original_test_intent.statement: Demonstrate GPU compute stability for 12 hours at 40 C and -5% rail margin with an approved burn tool and sensor monitoring.
must_preserve: GPU burn, 12 hours, 40 C, -5% rails and sensor evidence.
unknowns: GPU coverage, tool/profile, sensor limits, error policy and timing conflict.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It does not explicitly require every intended GPU identity/utilization nor flag the 240-minute metadata conflict.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep physical margin control manual and make GPU coverage, 12-hour duration and sensor/error thresholds auditable.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run 12-Hour GPU Burn at 40 C and -5% Rail Margin
revision_candidate.purpose: Load every owner-designated GPU for 12 hours under controlled high-temperature undervoltage and verify tool completion, sustained participation and clean health evidence.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Pinned GPU model/driver/tool profile with calibrated 40 C chamber and -5% rails.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Signed GPU UUID/BDF set; each must remain enumerated and measurably loaded for the required interval.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Tool source/hash/version/profile, GPU map, expected utilization, 12-hour/240-minute resolution, temperature/power/clock/ECC/XID limits, throttling policy and approval.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture baseline, let operator establish margin, run the exact burn profile for 12 hours with continuous per-GPU telemetry, preserve complete output and restore nominal conditions.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Cooling/power capacity, OOB monitoring, stable target map and recovery are verified.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: UUID/BDF/tool target mapping; command/version/hash/status; per-GPU utilization/temperature/power/clock/throttle/ECC/XID time series; kernel/BMC/SEL/AER deltas; full 12-hour continuity and restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Tool PASS plus continuous required GPU participation and no owner-disallowed sensor, error, reset or throttling condition.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not accept a tool banner alone, miss GPUs, clear logs, override power/clocks or shorten the run.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Lab operator controls chamber/rails and stop; GPU owner approves profile/limits.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Fixture is manual; bounded workload/telemetry can be automated under supervision.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Terminate load, restore nominal rails/temperature, verify every GPU/driver/link and recover only through the approved path.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Any GPU absent/not loaded, thermal/power limit, XID/ECC/AER/reset, hang, fixture drift or incomplete telemetry.

reason_for_change: A burn binary can report success while a GPU is omitted or throttled; V3 therefore binds PASS to stable identities, continuous participation and health telemetry.
remaining_blockers: Owner profile, coverage, thresholds and duration metadata.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 prevents a false all-GPU result from a single aggregate PASS and explicitly reconciles the source's 12-hour requirement with its four-hour machine-time field.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 25 explicitly says 12-hour GPU burn and sensor check at 40 C/-5%, with only a generic PASS criterion.
